note: Hold Do under a tune that starts on Sol, a 5th above, and steps down to meet it: the 5th over a drone, the tune learned in named stages at 40 bpm, then Do held under it. The old Key choice is moves (key any, tempo 40 to 60), and the line about another key opens with {{?key}}. Missing: a tool that plays a tune and listens for a held harmony note (melody-singer marks the tune's own notes, so a held Do reads as off the tune and the text sends the singer to their ears).

exercise.title: Hold Do, a 5th under the tune
exercise.why: The tune starts on Sol, a 5th above Do, and steps down until it lands on Do, so while you hold Do you hear the gap between the two parts close one step at a time.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. The drone holds {{1}}. Sing the low {{5}}, then drop to the low {{1}} and hold it. Sing it on "oo".
Practice until you find {{1}} from {{5}} without sliding.
_Don't reach for high notes: both notes are the low ones, near the drone._

Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. The tune starts on {{5}} and steps down to {{1}}. Sing along with it a few times, on the note names.
Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.

Tap the last note of the tune below to hear {{1}}. Then press Play below to start the tune, and hold that {{1}} from the first note to the last. Sing it on "oo".
Practice until your {{1}} stays put while the tune moves: the staff marks the tune's notes, not yours, so listen for the tune closing in on your note.
{{?key}}In another key the notes change, and the tune still starts a 5th above your {{1}}.
